notes: Fixed LAN persistent-reader deadlock in receiveActionAsync()
Root cause: reader thread looped indefinitely, consuming next turn's bytes before current turn finished, then ready() wiped the pre-delivered action
Fix: break out of reader loop after delivering ONE ACTION packet; guard resets in finally so receiveActionAsync() starts fresh reader each turn
New tests: LanPersistentReaderDeadlockTest (5 tests all pass)
Regression: all 98 existing LAN tests pass
